text:
Porter Martone is 20, the sixth overall pick in 2025, and the Flyers are asking him to learn a new position in his first full season. Philly Hockey Now's headline: "‘Anything The Team Needs’: Flyers’ Porter Martone Discusses Position Change." The Hockey News ranked him sixth among players 21 and under.

The early returns are mixed. He has 3 goals and 10 points in 27 games, 5 on the power play, which is 0.37 a game against a median of 0.44 for forwards picked in his range in their first full season. He's been unlucky finishing, 3 goals on 4.8 expected (the quality of his chances), and Philadelphia does about five points better by expected-goal share at five on five with him than without.

Charlie O'Connor summed up his Nov. 25 game in Washington: "Feels like baby steps from Martone right now." That's fair. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, from a small sample, says 70% of his shots come off the rush, and our range has him around 15 goals by April. Daily Faceoff wondered whether he can work back into the Calder conversation. The tools are here. The production is still catching up.
headline: Martone is learning on the fly
